description: This file defines the class S3EncryptionMultipartUploaderV2, which handles multipart encrypted uploads to Amazon S3 using AWS SDK for PHP. It extends MultipartUploader and integrates multiple traits related to encryption and metadata handling. The class includes methods for constructing the uploader with configuration options, checking supported ciphers, and preparing data for upload, focusing on encrypted multipart upload functionality.

classes.name: S3EncryptionMultipartUploaderV2
classes.description: A class that encapsulates multipart encrypted upload operations to Amazon S3, supporting advanced encryption options and custom metadata management.

methods.description: Checks if a given cipher name is supported by the SDK.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the multipart uploader with configuration, setting up encryption provider, metadata strategy, and preparing data source for encrypted upload.

methods.name: getDefaultStrategy
methods.description: Provides the default metadata storage strategy (HeadersMetadataStrategy).

methods.name: getEncryptingDataPreparer
methods.description: Returns a closure that defers encryption work until the upload promise is executed, encrypting data and preparing metadata envelope.
